texts.preamble: Rajinder Pal vs State Of Haryana on 18 May, 2016 104 Crm Nos.15952 and 15953 of 2016 in Crr No.253 of 2000 Rajinder Pal Vs State Of Haryana Present: Mr. S.K.S. Bedi, Advocate for the applicant. ----- Crm-15952-2016 Application is allowed as prayed for. Crm-15953-2016
texts.facts: Still not satisfied, another application was filed for recalling the order dated 29.04.2016 for deposit of balance amount of fine of `4,000/-, which was dismissed by the court on May 09, 2016.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the balance amount of fine has been deposited and receipt of the same is attached with the application. It is further contended by the counsel for the applicant that the brother of the applicant was pursuing the litigation on behalf of the applicant and was in contact with him. Later on, he suffered paralytic attack in brain and lost his memory. Therefore, the letter sent by the counsel was not responded.
